## 4. Upper bound of the bypass action: ALWAYS (every store restricted) vs NONE on each attack

From `analysis/results.csv`; `ratio` = array_writes_total ALWAYS / NONE. Mean ratio 0.919, median 0.997, minimum 0.792: bypassing every store removes at most 20.8 % of the array writes, because a bypassed store invalidates its line and the next load refills (and writes) it (`refills after bypass`).
